_about: Sir Frederic G. Kenyon (1863-1952), Director of the British Museum: Classical Texts from Papyri in the British Museum, including the newly discovered poems of Herodas (1891); The Palaeography of Greek Papyri (Oxford, 1899); and the British Museum's Greek Papyri catalogue, Vols. I-II (1893, 1898) by Kenyon, Vol. III (1907) by Kenyon and H. I. Bell, and Vols. IV-V (1910, 1917) by Bell, kept here with their series. Greek-heavy; kept per Adam's 2026-10-23 ruling. His Bible and textual-criticism books are lane A's; his Browning editions are outside lane B. Classical scholarship (lane B, round dl: Internet Archive call-number sweep). Raw IA OCR. No uids minted.
